components.name: Primary action
components.description: Full-width planning action; disabled at 0.45 opacity.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:7px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;background:var(--green,#244eca);color:white;border:0;width:100%;min-height:52px}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#17399b}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #355ddd;outline-offset:4px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:7px;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;background:white;border:1px solid #b7c3d8}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e8edf9}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #355ddd;outline-offset:4px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Request field
components.description: Resizable scene request with a persistent label.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">원하는 느낌이나 장면을 알려주세요<textarea placeholder="예: 촉촉하고 고급스러운 세럼 광고 사진."></textarea></label>
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-field textarea{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);display:block;margin-top:10px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:142px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #b7c3d8;border-radius:8px;background:white;resize:vertical;font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;caret-color:#244eca;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s}.ds-field textarea::placeholder{color:#5d6b81;opacity:1}.ds-field textarea:focus{border-color:#244eca}.ds-field textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #355ddd;outline-offset:4px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-field textarea{transition:none}}

components.name: Studio navigation
components.description: Two routes; current route uses navy fill.
components.html: 1 제품 촬영2 연출 기획
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:8px;font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);font-size:13px}.ds-nav a{padding:12px 18px;border-radius:7px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted,#56657b)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{background:var(--ink,#18253d);color:white}.ds-nav a:hover{opacity:.85}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #355ddd;outline-offset:4px;}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-nav a{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:11px}}

components.name: Active step
components.css: .ds-step{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);display:inline-flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;color:var(--green,#244eca);font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.ds-step>span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green,#244eca);color:white;font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Source label
components.description: Static label over original product imagery.
components.css: .ds-source{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);display:inline-block;font-size:10px;background:white;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px}

components.name: Plan sheet
components.description: Static shot definitions with thin row dividers.
components.html:
배경
밝은 화이트 무광 배경
빛
부드러운 확산광, 정면 위주
components.css: .ds-sheet{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);margin:0;padding:18px 22px;background:white;border:1px solid var(--line,#d7deea);border-radius:8px}.ds-sheet>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:84px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf0f6}.ds-sheet>div:last-child{border:0}.ds-sheet dt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#56657b)}.ds-sheet dd{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-sheet{padding:14px}.ds-sheet>div{grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px}.ds-sheet dd{font-size:12px}}

components.name: Photo upload
components.description: Native file input over a dashed tile.
components.html: <label class="ds-upload"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 4v16M4 12h16"/></svg>사진 추가<input type="file" accept="image/*" aria-label="제품 사진 추가"></label>
components.css: .ds-upload{font-family:Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#18253d);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:110px;height:110px;border:1px dashed var(--line,#d7deea);border-radius:6px;background:#e9eef8;color:#244eca;position:relative;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-upload:hover{background:#e8edf9}.ds-upload:focus-within{outline:3px solid #355ddd;outline-offset:3px}.ds-upload input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}@media(max-width:650px){.ds-upload{width:96px;height:96px}}

narrative.overview: A restrained product-catalog studio: cool paper, navy ink, cobalt actions and large product photographs. The interface stays quiet while capture evidence and concrete shot instructions carry the work. This records the implemented code-led direction, not an approved visual comp.
keyCharacteristics: One Korean sans stack across capture and planning.
Photographic context beside a focused task; tasks precede imagery on phones.
Thin dividers, compact control corners and flat tonal surfaces.
dos: Keep product evidence visibly separate from staging references.
Label synthetic examples and keep original product identity legible.
Preserve visible keyboard focus and 44px primary interaction targets.
Check the 700px stacked layout as well as desktop and 390px phone views.
donts: Do not present the example photograph as a customer capture or an image generated by the app.
Do not reintroduce the rejected pale-green interface palette.
Do not replace sequential direction comparisons with a decorative dashboard card grid.
Do not infer a loaded webfont from the preferred family name.
